description: A `{ … }` attribute value whose element ends at a trailing `/` before the value's `}` (`header={<h1>Hi/}`) uses the RETIRED trailing-slash closer (§4.4, Appendix E) — refused with E-SYNTAX-050 and the Appendix E hint. A bootstrap-gradable twin of error-boundary/terse-fallback-closer-neg (which the bootstrap grades UNSUPPORTED: `<errorBoundary>` is refused by name).
rationale: Appendix E (2026-04-09): "Any source file using bare `/` or trailing content`/` closers SHALL be rejected by the compiler with a diagnostic pointing to §4.4. The diagnostic SHALL include a hint: 'Did you mean `</>`?'". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md "⭐ RULED — the `/}` 'terse closer' is the retired trailing-slash closer; Appendix E governs (S482)". #2095 review LOW-5.
